en konkurrent.explanation: "En konkurrent" means "a competitor". It comes from the verb "at konkurrere" (to compete).

en konsekvens.explanation: "En konsekvens" means "a consequence". To say something will have consequences, use "at få konsekvenser" (to have consequences): "Det vil få konsekvenser" (There will be consequences). Do not mix it up with the adjective "konsekvent" (consistent): "Hun er altid konsekvent" (She is always consistent).

en konsistens.explanation: "En konsistens" means "a texture". Do not use it for English "consistency" in the sense of doing the same thing each time. For that, use "konsekvent" (consistent): "Hun er altid konsekvent" (She is always consistent).

en konsonant.explanation: "En konsonant" means "a consonant". To name the other kind of letter, use "en vokal" (a vowel): "E er en vokal" (E is a vowel).

en konsulent.explanation: "En konsulent" means "a consultant". It comes from the verb "at konsultere" (to consult).

en kontakt.explanation: "En kontakt" means "a contact / a switch". When you talk about a person you know who can help you, it means "a contact": "Jeg har en kontakt i banken" (I have a contact at the bank). When you talk about the thing you press to turn on a light, it means "a switch": "Kontakten er ved døren" (The switch is by the door).

en kontaktlinse.explanation: "En kontaktlinse" means "a contact lens". It is built from "en kontakt" (a contact) and "en linse" (a lens).

en kontaktløs betaling.explanation: "En kontaktløs betaling" means "a contactless payment". The ending "-løs" means "without": "kontaktløs" is "without contact", and "håbløs" (hopeless) uses the same ending.

en kontaktperson.explanation: "En kontaktperson" means "a contact person". To say a man or a woman is the contact person, the word stays the same: "Han er vores kontaktperson" (He is our contact person) and "Hun er vores kontaktperson" (She is our contact person).

en kontekst.explanation: "En kontekst" means "a context". To say words are used in the wrong setting, use "taget ud af kontekst" (taken out of context): "Ordene er taget ud af kontekst" (The words are taken out of context).

en konto.explanation: "En konto" means "an account", as in an account at a bank. To say you open one, use "at oprette" (to open, to set up): "Jeg vil gerne oprette en konto" (I would like to open an account).

en kontorassistent.explanation: "En kontorassistent" means "an office assistant". It is built from "et kontor" (an office) and "en assistent" (an assistant).

en kontorplads.explanation: "En kontorplads" means "a workspace". For a whole room, use "et kontor" (an office): "Jeg har mit eget kontor" (I have my own office).

en kontorstol.explanation: "En kontorstol" means "an office chair". It is built from "et kontor" (an office) and "en stol" (a chair). The word "stol" also appears in "en spisestol" (a dining chair).

en kontrakt.explanation: "En kontrakt" means "a contract". For an agreement that is only spoken, use "en aftale" (an agreement): "Vi har en mundtlig aftale" (We have a spoken agreement).

en kontrast.explanation: "En kontrast" means "a contrast". To compare two things, use "i kontrast til" (in contrast to): "I kontrast til sommeren er vinteren mørk" (In contrast to the summer, the winter is dark).

en kontrol.explanation: "En kontrol" means "a check / control". When the police or a border guard stops you to look at your papers, it means "a check": "Der er kontrol ved grænsen" (There is a check at the border). When you talk about power over something, it means "control": "Han har kontrol over bilen" (He has control of the car).

en kontrolafgift.explanation: "En kontrolafgift" means "a penalty fare". It is built from "en kontrol" (a check) and "en afgift" (a fee). To say you must pay it, say: "Jeg skal betale en kontrolafgift" (I have to pay a penalty fare).

en koordinat.explanation: "En koordinat" means "a coordinate". To ask for the place of something, use the plural: "Send mig koordinaterne til stedet" (Send me the coordinates for the place).

en kop.explanation: "En kop" means "a cup". To name what is in the cup, put the drink straight after "kop", with no word for "of": "en kop te" (a cup of tea).

en kopi.explanation: "En kopi" means "a copy". To ask someone to make one, use "at lave" (to make): "Kan du lave en kopi af nøglen?" (Can you make a copy of the key?)

en kopimaskine.explanation: "En kopimaskine" means "a copier". It is built from "en kopi" (a copy) and "en maskine" (a machine). The word "maskine" also appears in "en vaskemaskine" (a washing machine).

en korporal.explanation: "En korporal" means "a corporal". To use the rank with a name, put it before the name: "korporal Hansen" (Corporal Hansen).

en kosmetolog.explanation: "En kosmetolog" means "a beautician". For someone who cuts hair, use "en frisør" (a hairdresser): "Frisøren klipper mit hår" (The hairdresser cuts my hair).

en kost.explanation: "En kost" means "a broom". In a different meaning, the word "kost" without "en" means "diet": "sund kost" (a healthy diet). For cleaning a floor with electricity, use "en støvsuger" (a vacuum cleaner): "Støvsugeren står i skabet" (The vacuum cleaner is in the cupboard).
